stage: Build18-1 Grounded WhyNow Specification / Architecture Freeze
responsibility: Project already-resolved analysis into explanation-safe, traceable claims without changing Intent, Confidence, evidence weights, detectors, or resolver behavior.
pipelinePosition: Fact -> ContextChange -> Effect -> Intent -> Outcome -> Confidence -> GroundedExplanationContext -> Explanation
invariants: GroundedExplanationContext never creates or re-ranks Intent candidates
every verbalized non-generic claim traces to sourceEvidenceIDs or sourceSignalIDs
Effect never becomes an Intent/purpose claim merely because the effect occurred
geometry never independently supports a purpose claim
opening/precedent knowledge never independently creates Intent
LOW and UNRESOLVED never emit assertive purpose claims
missing evidence is safer than invented evidence

sourceEvidenceIDs.meaning: MoveContextAnalysis.evidence ids actually supporting the claim

sourceSignalIDs.meaning: facts/contextChanges/effects/outcomes ids used for observed claims

observedChange.rule: Only from directly represented before/after or explicit signal detail; no inferred motive

safeToVerbalize.rule: False if traceability, layer correctness, compatibility, or uncertainty gate fails

compatibleIntent.rule: May equal selectedIntent only; never an alternate intent generated by explanation layer

detail.rule: Structured human-readable material; must preserve source semantic layer

specializedContext.rule: Explanation-only; cannot carry intent weight or confidence override

constructionRules: Project candidates only after MoveContextAnalysis is complete.
Match evidence to selectedIntent for purpose-supporting explanation; unrelated evidence may appear only as clearly separated observed effect when compatibility rules permit.
For INTENT claims, wording comes from the already selected Intent, while evidence details support why-now context; evidence detail itself does not invent purpose.
For EFFECT claims, use effect/change wording such as 'increased/decreased/became' and forbid 'in order to/aim/purpose' wording unless independently backed as selected Intent.
For UNCERTAINTY claims, list only missing-evidence reasons whose absence or instability is directly inspectable.
At most one specialized/concept supplement per position unless a later architecture amendment explicitly changes Build17-5's cap.
